claims.evidence: The witness report does not show key yellowing, cracks, or stickiness.

The witness report shows the Yamaha brand but not the model SX-600; model is listed as null.

risks.risk: The keyboard does not power on or some keys do not function.
risks.proof: A video of the unit powering on and every key being played.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, for spares or repairs

risks.risk: Keys have yellowing, cracks, or stickiness.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keybed and body from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Power adapter, stand, or bench are missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories together.
risks.if_unproven: as unit only, with no accessories

risks.risk: Age or usage history is unknown and may be high.
risks.proof: An original receipt or serial number check.
risks.if_unproven: as an older, heavily used unit

risks.risk: The model is not actually an SX-600.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label or nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic Yamaha keyboard without SX-600 value

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model label or nameplate
Video of the keyboard powering on and all keys sounding
Close-up photos of the keys and body for wear
Photo of any power adapter, stand, bench, or other accessories
response.reason: The witness identifies a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst case even though the model, function, and condition are unproven.
